data.name: संदीप
data.gender_notes: संदीप is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name संदीप is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘सं’ (meaning ‘completely’) and ‘दीप’ (meaning ‘light’ or ‘knowledge’). It symbolizes the one who illuminates the path with the light of knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is referred to as ‘संदीपनाथ’, the lord of those who illuminate the path. The name संदीप carries the meaning “Light of Knowledge or Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose संदीप usually hope their child will grow to embody light of knowledge or wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Illuminates the path with the light of knowledge and wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of संदीप total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
